\section[(dialogue)]{Describing words and verbs — a first pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R176-first-pass-describing-words-and-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to fall and to live.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item clever, lazy, calm, busy, expensive
  \item cheap, wrong, complete, to run, to walk
  \item to get up, to sleep, to wake up, to bathe, to wash
  \item to cook, to give, to bring, to call, to cry
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Clever? (\textbf{\ml{ബുദ്ധിയുള്ള}}, \emph{buddhiyuḷḷa}.) Lazy? (\textbf{\ml{മടിയുള്ള}}, \emph{maṭiyuḷḷa}.) Calm? (\textbf{\ml{ശാന്തമായ}}, \emph{śāntamāya}.) Busy? (\textbf{\ml{തിരക്കുള്ള}}, \emph{tirakkuḷḷa}.) Expensive? (\textbf{\ml{വിലകൂടിയ}}, \emph{vilakūṭiya}.) Cheap? (\textbf{\ml{വിലകുറഞ്ഞ}}, \emph{vilakuṟañña}.) Wrong? (\textbf{\ml{തെറ്റായ}}, \emph{teṟṟāya}.) Complete? (\textbf{\ml{പൂർണ്ണമായ}}, \emph{pūrṇamāya}.) To run? (\textbf{\ml{ഓടുക}}, \emph{ōṭuka}.) To walk? (\textbf{\ml{നടക്കുക}}, \emph{naṭakkuka}.) To get up? (\textbf{\ml{എഴുന്നേൽക്കുക}}, \emph{eḻunnēlkkuka}.) To sleep? (\textbf{\ml{ഉറങ്ങുക}}, \emph{uṟaṅṅuka}.) To wake up? (\textbf{\ml{ഉണരുക}}, \emph{uṇaruka}.) To bathe? (\textbf{\ml{കുളിക്കുക}}, \emph{kuḷikkuka}.) To wash? (\textbf{\ml{കഴുകുക}}, \emph{kaḻukuka}.) To cook? (\textbf{\ml{വേവിക്കുക}}, \emph{vēvikkuka}.) To give? (\textbf{\ml{കൊടുക്കുക}}, \emph{koṭukkuka}.) To bring? (\textbf{\ml{കൊണ്ടുവരുക}}, \emph{koṇṭuvaruka}.) To call? (\textbf{\ml{വിളിക്കുക}}, \emph{viḷikkuka}.) To cry? (\textbf{\ml{കരയുക}}, \emph{karayuka}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Verbs — a second pass}

\label{lesson:ML-R176-second-pass-verbs}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for to laugh and to look.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item to laugh, to look, to study, to teach, to begin
  \item to stop, to wait, to search, to find, to forget
  \item to love, to sell, to send, to throw, to climb
  \item to get down, to swim, to jump, to fall, to live
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
To laugh? (\textbf{\ml{ചിരിക്കുക}}, \emph{cirikkuka}.) To look? (\textbf{\ml{നോക്കുക}}, \emph{nōkkuka}.) To study? (\textbf{\ml{പഠിക്കുക}}, \emph{paṭhikkuka}.) To teach? (\textbf{\ml{പഠിപ്പിക്കുക}}, \emph{paṭhippikkuka}.) To begin? (\textbf{\ml{തുടങ്ങുക}}, \emph{tuṭaṅṅuka}.) To stop? (\textbf{\ml{നിർത്തുക}}, \emph{nirttuka}.) To wait? (\textbf{\ml{കാത്തിരിക്കുക}}, \emph{kāttirikkuka}.) To search? (\textbf{\ml{തിരയുക}}, \emph{tirayuka}.) To find? (\textbf{\ml{കണ്ടെത്തുക}}, \emph{kaṇṭettuka}.) To forget? (\textbf{\ml{മറക്കുക}}, \emph{maṟakkuka}.) To love? (\textbf{\ml{സ്നേഹിക്കുക}}, \emph{snēhikkuka}.) To sell? (\textbf{\ml{വിൽക്കുക}}, \emph{vilkkuka}.) To send? (\textbf{\ml{അയയ്ക്കുക}}, \emph{ayaykkuka}.) To throw? (\textbf{\ml{എറിയുക}}, \emph{eṟiyuka}.) To climb? (\textbf{\ml{കയറുക}}, \emph{kayaṟuka}.) To get down? (\textbf{\ml{ഇറങ്ങുക}}, \emph{iṟaṅṅuka}.) To swim? (\textbf{\ml{നീന്തുക}}, \emph{nīntuka}.) To jump? (\textbf{\ml{ചാടുക}}, \emph{cāṭuka}.) To fall? (\textbf{\ml{വീഴുക}}, \emph{vīḻuka}.) To live? (\textbf{\ml{ജീവിക്കുക}}, \emph{jīvikkuka}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
